data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Germanic elements berht (bright, famous) and wald (rule, power), Bartosch can be interpreted as 'bright ruler'. The name Bartosch carries the meaning “Bright, radiant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Bartosch may evoke images of brave warriors, wise rulers, or powerful figures in myth and legend who embodied these qualities.
